description: Integrate StickerEditor into JournalEditorPage.vue with full state management, persistence, and interaction flow. This wires the existing sticker components (created by prior workflow but never connected) into the actual journal editing experience with load/save handlers, dirty state tracking, and proper Moveable integration for drag/resize/rotate.
steps: 1. Import StickerEditor component in JournalEditorPage.vue script section after PhotoUpload import (line 15): import StickerEditor from '@/components/journal/StickerEditor.vue'
2. Add sticker reactive state after uploadingPhotos ref (line 48): stickersDirty = ref(false), stickerEditorRef = ref<InstanceType<typeof StickerEditor> | null>(null)
3. Add handleStickerDirtyChange function after closePickers (line 523): sets stickersDirty.value and calls markDirty() if dirty is true
4. Update handleSave function (around line 295, after successful journal save) to call stickerEditorRef.value?.savePlacements() with try-catch error handling
5. Update onBeforeRouteLeave guard (line 110) to check both isDirty.value and stickersDirty.value before showing unsaved changes warning

6. Render StickerEditor in template after form content (line 784): ref=stickerEditorRef, :entry-id=savedEntryId||null, :view-mode=false, :user-id=store.user?.id, @dirty-change=handleStickerDirtyChange, @placements-change=markDirty

7. Verify all 5 sticker child components render correctly: StickerCanvas with Moveable bindings, StickerTray with 12 built-in SVG thumbnails from public/stickers-builtin/, StickerToolbar with layer/rotation/duplicate/delete controls, StickerPlacement with normalized coordinate transforms

8. Test complete interaction flow: click Decorate button -> sticker tray opens -> click thumbnail -> sticker appears on canvas -> drag/resize/rotate with Moveable -> toolbar controls work -> undo/redo work -> save persists to Supabase journal_sticker_placements table
9. Test load flow: edit existing entry -> placements load from database -> stickers render in saved positions with correct z-index layering
10. Verify mobile responsive: sticker tray becomes bottom sheet on <768px, touch drag/resize/rotate work, toolbar remains visible and centered
